body:
I was in the military when all of this happened to me back in 2005. I was kicked out of the military for drug use, inhalants Nitrous Oxide, whippets. I was buying cases of whippets through the internet and they would deliver the cases to my front door. I was stationed in NAS Oceana in VA Beach, VA at the time and just moved into a new condo with 2 other roommates that were in the same duty station as me.
Every pay day, the 1st or 15th, I would buy 2 cases of whippets and inhale all of it within a couple of days. I was completely out of my mind and body. To me I thought I was accessing kundalini or something, unlocking my chakras. Whatever my purpose was, it was totally spiritual. I played Ouija Board in the past, one time, I played by myself and I knew at the time that you were not supposed to do that but something came over me, drawing me to try it. Anyways, during my heavy nitrous oxide use, a spirit, entity, or demon, made a hole in my aura and entered my being. I remember that I would go outside to smoke  a cigarette and there was this teenage boy that I saw come out into his backyard and looked at me or was watching the progress of the spirit entrance into my aura. He was dressed all in black and I remember seeing him do this at least 2 times, while he was talking to himself. After a while, I started to think that this teenager was a witch or was practicing black magic and placing a curse on me. Im not sure what his intentions were because it was from a distance, at least 300 to 500 yards away.
The whole process lasted about 2 weeks as I began hearing multiple voices during my nitrous oxide abuse. My career in the military began to fall apart
I began hearing multiple voices during my nitrous oxide abuse. My career in the military began to fall apart
, I would come into work late constantly, I would not show up to events that I was scheduled to be a part of. Then one of my roommates noticed my heavy nitrous oxide use and reported my actions to the superiors at work. I understand that he was only concerned for my well being but eventually, his report caused my downfall and separation from the military. My command was well aware now that I had been using nitrous oxide or my addiction to it. I was discharged as a General Under Honorable Conditions but I had access to all my VA benefits at least, like being able to use my GI Bill for college.
So after the military, I eventually ended up living in Las Vegas. My mom and grandma were living together and my mom wanted to help me out with my living situation. So I moved to Las Vegas in 2006 but my addiction to nitrous oxide continued there as well. I stopped buying cases of whippets on the internet and discovered local smoke shops were selling it over the counter. After a few months of looking for jobs, I landed a great job at a hotel and casino. I was making good money but that just fueled my addiction. I continued my nitrous oxide abuse for a few years in Las Vegas. I was wasting my lots of money on whippets. I did so much that one day, I woke up and had trouble walking, it would hurt to walk. I started having trouble at work because it was hard to walk around. I even began using a cane.
Well, my performance at work was declining due to my addiction to nitrous oxide. I was fired from my job. So I was in limbo and had moved in with my sister at the time. Still not being able to walk, I couldnt even go to the supermarket to shop for food. I would have to give money to sister so she could go shopping for me. I was becoming a burden. So during this whole time, I still had the spirit in my aura and it possessed me. I had another sister that was living in Wisconsin at the time and offered me to move there to live with my step dad because my health was struggling and I needed help, so I moved to Wisconsin in 2009. In Wisconsin, I lived with my step dad while still having a hard time walking and still hearing multiple voices from the spirit in my aura. I was not able to work so I applied for assistance. I was diagnosed as schizophrenic and put on medication and I had peripheral neuropathy, nerve damage in my legs, a side effect of heavy nitrous oxide use. Luckily, my disability was approved and I started to get money monthly. I slowly began to walk better again, I built up strength. At least I was able to walk again but my nitrous oxide addiction kicked in again. So I started buying whippets online again and hiding it from my step dad but he eventually found out and intervened. I stopped using nitrous oxide because of this but eventually, my step dad moved to Michigan and my step sister and her family, moved in with me. So my nitrous oxide use started up again and soon I found that I was hiding it from my step sister. She found out and had a talk with me and I stopped using.
By this time, I had done so many whippets that the drug did not have the effects that it used to have. It became harder for me to think of ideas or to even find the right words to say. I believe that I soon suffered from brain damage because of all the nitrous I inhaled. Although, I was able to use my GI Bill for college, I did not complete my degree. I went to school for 3 years and found that the classes they offered were not to my liking. And I was seeing a psychologist and a psychiatrist during my time living in Wisconsin at the VA clinic for free. Nothing good was happening for me at all. I could not find the right job. I would work a job for a few months but ended up quitting because I did not like it. So for a couple of years, I would do this, I would get hired and end up quitting. My step sister was getting tired of this pattern. She knew that I needed money because for me, it was expensive to live in the situation I was in. Eventually, she asked me if I should move to Michigan with my step dad and I accepted. So moved to Michigan and lived on a farm with my step dad. I had stopped using nitrous oxide completely and was completely sober. I did not like the living situation in Michigan so I asked my mom if I could move back to Las Vegas with her. She was reluctant at first but after thinking about it, she agreed because I was offering to help pay for rent with my monthly disability checks. This whole time, I was still hearing voices from the spirit in my aura. I moved back to Las Vegas in 2014.
Now presently, I am still hearing voices and have checked into the VA clinic in Las Vegas, still on medications. I am still looking for jobs. So the moral of this story is, do not use nitrous oxide to excess. It has ruined my life.
